none: PAS CAM-707E9D: Roman Coin : Nummus of the House of Valentinian - SECVRITAS [REI PVBLICAE].
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A slightly incomplete copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian AD 364-378 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads SECVRITAS [REI PVBLICAE].Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding wreath and palm. Mint is uncertain. Obverse shows a diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Reverse fields and exergue read: OF/III//[...]. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is…
